notes.title: German Flood Relief
notes.notes:
We are following the events in the flooded areas with sadness and deep sympathy and are shocked how many people have lost their lives, their livelihood, or their life's work. Our thoughts are with those affected and their families who are still - after the water slowly recedes - holding out in uncertainty and fighting for their belongings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976304/63bba9aaf4ca1507294280aa242a612f8e88d72a.jpg[/img]

We are full of pride and admiration for the service of volunteers, farmers, firefighters, soldiers, police officers, and disaster services who are working day and night in the flooded areas and who are sacrificially working under the most adverse circumstances for the people in need. 

[h2]We do our part![/h2]

Together with our studios Massive Miniteam ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1002000/SPITLINGS/]Spitlings[/url]), Paintbucket Games ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003090/Through_the_Darkest_of_Times/]Through The Darkest Of Times[/url]) and Honig Studios ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/853050/El_Hijo__A_Wild_West_Tale/]El Hijo - A Wild West Tale[/url]), we started a Steam event - [i][b]German Flood Relief[/b][/i] - where [b]20% of every purchase[/b] will be donated to [url=https://www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de/en/]Aktion Deutschland Hilft[/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/HandyGames/sale/GermanFloodReliefEvent

Separately, [b]we are donating an additional 30,000 Euros[/b] to [i]Aktion Deutschland Hilft[/i]! As part of [i]Embracer Group[/i] and the [i]THQ Nordic[/i] family, it's natural for us to stand united even in hard times, give back, and make the world a better place.

The Steam event includes a total of 37 games and 5 DLCs - among them such hits as El Hijo - A Wild West Tale (Best German Family Game 2021, winner of the Goldener Spatz), Through The Darkest Of Times (multiple winner of the German Computer Game Award (DCP), German Developer Award (DEP) and Indie Award Nominee at Gamescom), Little Big Workshop, Clouds & Sheep 2, Spitlings, Aces of the Luftwaffe Squadrons or the Townsmen series.

 
[url=https://www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de/en/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976304/2c74bbc4cd68086b1bad53b4289c9f4ef252b0e8.png[/img][/url]
 

Aktion Deutschland Hilft is an alliance of renowned German aid organizations that works together to help people who have lost everything due to major disasters.

If you would like to help beyond German Flood Relief, or if you already have all of our games, you can do so quickly and easily on the site www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de. The donations go directly to where they are needed.

Thank you and stay safe <3

notes.title: El Hijo - A Wild West Tale Wins Award at DCP 2021!
notes.notes:
El Hijo – A Wild West Tale by HandyGames, international indie-publisher from Giebelstadt, Germany was voted Best Family Game by the Der Deutsche Computerspielpreis jury.

Precisely because of its setting and accessibility, as well as the unique atmosphere and emotional story, the game is equally enjoyable for younger players and adults alike. The jury has been convinced by the exciting Wild West adventure which families can experience collectively.

The spaghetti-western stealth game has already been named Best Indie-Title by the gamescom-Award in 2019.

notes.title: Once upon a time in the wild, wild west...
notes.notes:
The boy with the slingshot. A young child, full of hope. A trickster, as smart as he is. Inspiring all children of the West. Challenging his fate, he sneaks through the darkest places, exposing himself to wild dangers and adventures - only to finally be reunited with his mother after tragedy struck and the young family got separated.

With tricky puzzles, shady monks, and dancing cowboys, playing through this gloomy, yet wholesome, adventure is a lot of fun. But what happens if a diversion fails and your fireworks hit the pecking chicken instead of an opponent? Find out for yourself and discover the Wild, Wild West.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32693284/31d97d30216a1106323363edd10750ee1bcdbe95.png[/img]

[h2]Sit down and buckle up for a fantastic stealth adventure.[/h2]
El Hijo - A Wild West Tale is a non-violent game and an engaging story of an adventurous child looking for his mother. The child sneaks past different sorts of suspicious outlaws in a series of diverse western settings.
Instead of violence, the child's imaginative playfulness is used with the help of his toys, which serve to distract his "opponents".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32693284/b9ec31db0fe2d51c8c54ca154c4274b7532fe2e4.jpg[/img]

Using the shadows to his advantage is a core element of the game, as the young hero will often have to hide. Various twists on familiar mechanics are often a product of the challenging and increasingly dangerous environments that the 6-year-old must traverse to reach his ultimate goal.

Thanks to the community and enjoy "El Hijo - A Wild West Tale"
Your El Hijo Team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32693284/7b49d13f2b78053bac3f88e58a5e6250befbd668.png[/img]

notes.title: The West is getting Wild this Winter!
notes.notes:
Whip out your poncho and get your slingshot ready to cause havoc and mischief! El Hijo - A Wild West Tale is saddling up on [b]December 3rd, 2020! [/b]

[h2]A really wild west tale![/h2]
What would you do as 6-year-old kid, who must flee from violent outlaws in the Wild West? Violence is not an option! So you hide in the shadows, sneak around, and inspire other children on your way to freedom.

[h2]A playful child on his way out [/h2]
Equipped with a slingshot, stones, and tricky toys, used to distract and disarm enemies you will make your way through dark monastery corners, parched deserts, and lawless boomtowns while you discover a world full of suspicious monks, dangerous bandits, and mischievous desperadoes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32693284/2eccfbffb83ae291d0e118b61a9d0380d85c697a.png[/img]

Shoot small rocks at lamps, create noisy distractions using fireworks or toy soldiers, and more to outsmart different types of opponents, and stay in the shadows on your quest to liberate yourself and other children from the chains of an evil syndicate and reunite with your mother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32693284/c0c47e6be22d8074896aa9fdc1051dbde8bcba76.png[/img]

You've been waiting a long time to play the young, brave child and now is the right time to put El Hijo on your wishlist to not miss the release and any discounts! 

Thanks for your support!
<3

Pass by and say hi - and play the most recent demo of El Hijo! Sneak past some vigilant monks, outsmart the guards and take the chance to escape the monastery ... maybe? 

We're looking forward chatting with you and talk about our game! 

See you in Boston!
